title.value: tert-Butyldimethylsilyl-Directed Highly Enantioselective Approach to Axially Chiral a-Allenols

abstract.value: A highly efficient and enantioselective synthesis of axially chiral a-allenols was realized in practical yields with 96–99 % ee or de from TBS-protected propargylic alcohols, aldehydes, and a commercially available, inexpensive, chiral, secondary amine (S)-a,a-diphenylprolinol or its enantiomer followed by desilylation. The easily removable TBS group not only acts as a protecting group, but also as a possible sterically directing group for the excellent enantioselectivity and in situ prevention of possible allene racemization. Keywords: allenes · amines · chirality · enantioselectivity · steric hindrance
